thread:
Alex: quick heads-up — brought up quant-13b-v2 (4-bit) with a speculative decode path (early-commit beamlet). running shadow traffic on dedicated pool.
Maya: nice. quick numbers?
Alex: posting short dump. TL;DR: ~1.9x token throughput, p99 latency +12ms, but summarization RG-L down ~0.04 vs baseline.
Alex: ```
Run: ./bin/eval_runner --model quant-13b-v2 --decode speculative --prefill warm --suite summarization_v1
Throughput: 1.9x (tokens/sec relative)
Latency p50: -15ms, p95: -8ms, p99: +12ms
ROUGE-L: baseline 0.78 -> 0.74 (-4.8%)
Human-pass@3: 78% -> 72% (-6)
Flip-rate on safety prompts: 0.6% -> 0.9%
Config snippet:
spec_decode:
  early_commit_threshold: 0.35
  beamlet_width: 2
  fallback: quant-13b-v1
  kv_prefetch: true
```
Raj: interesting. is the p99 increase only on long-context samples?
Alex: yes, p99 regression concentrated on >1k token outputs. shorter prompts dominated the throughput win.
Zoe: could be KV cache warmup + mispredicted early commits causing more full-decode fallbacks for long outputs. also check batch composition changes between runs.
Maya: did you run a deterministic baseline (greedy) vs topk/top-p? need the sampling parity.
Alex: baseline was greedy; speculative used topk=40, temp=0.7 (we used a small entropy gate). switching to topk=20 lowered quality drop but reduced throughput to 1.6x.
Raj: can you paste the fail cases? small examples help.
Alex: ```
Input: "Summarize the following article... (long)"
Baseline:
  "Article summary paragraph..."
Speculative-output:
  "Shorter summary missing key claim about X."
Notes: model tended to commit early on repeated boilerplate tokens, missed important final clause.
```
Zoe: maybe tune early_commit_threshold up (0.5) for long-context cohort, or add a length-aware gate: disable early-commit when expected_remaining_tokens > 300.
Maya: agree. also run the same spec config but quant-13b-v1 (older quant) to see whether quantization interacts with commit heuristics.
Alex: scheduled A/B today: (1) threshold 0.5 for long outputs, (2) disable speculative for >1024 context, (3) spec on quant-13b-v1. will run with the same seed. starting now.
ops-bot: test-run queued: job_id=run-2026-05-14-0442, est ~45m. :gear:
Raj: quick ask — include the eval harness key metric 'semantic-fidelity' (embedding cosine vs. ref) in additions. numeric drift helps triage.
Maya: +1. and add a small human spot-check on 50 long summaries.
Alex: will post results here. thanks all :thumbsup:
Zoe: FYI, if we still see p99 regressions after tweaks, we should consider a graded fallback: allow speculative for first 800 tokens then force deterministic after.
Maya: good plan. keep logs of fallback counts per-request too.
Alex: noted. putting instrumentation hooks in eval runner now. will update in ~1h.
